plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Airspan wireless device. It reports uptime, temperature, interface traffic, and voltage (enterprise PEN 989).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-sensor temperature from the PEN 989 sensor temperature monitor table. The Integer32 value is already in degrees Celsius, so the query does not scale it. Empty temperature tables yield no rows. Persistently high values may indicate cooling problems, high ambient temperature, or hardware thermal stress.

metrics.name: device_temperature_status
metrics.description: Optional per-sensor temperature status from the same PEN 989 temperature monitor index. Values are normal(0), tooHigh(1) and tooLow(2). Empty temperature tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Optional per-sensor DC voltage from the PEN 989 DC voltage monitor table. The Integer32 value is millivolts and is scaled by /1000 in the query to volts. Empty voltage tables yield no rows. Values far from the expected DC rail may indicate power or hardware risk.

metrics.name: device_voltage_status
metrics.description: Optional per-sensor DC voltage status from the same PEN 989 voltage monitor index. Values are nominal(0), tooHigh(1), tooLow(2) and outOfRange(3). Empty voltage tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
